input_types: R0: one bounded JSON request with a task scope and 1–32 caller-selected execution receipts.
R1: the same scope with 1–32 receipts plus local source/input/output paths and SHA-256 bindings; preserved negative outcomes also bind failure bytes.
required_outputs: R0: deterministic result with optional-reference, counterexample, review-required, or withhold decisions.
R1: the same decisions plus per-artifact binding status and an aggregate read-byte count bounded to 8 MiB.
